warnings: All bars are printed with Ø → type RB. Beam sections are drawn turned 90° on the sheet: the short printed dimension is the width, the long one the depth (B1/B2/R1 0.15 x 0.40, B4 0.20 x 0.50, R2 0.15 x 0.20).

Label order on every beam is top bars / stirrup / '(คมL/5)' bars / bottom bars, and the '(คมL/5)' leader points to a second bar pair on the bottom face. 'คม' = คอม้า (bent-up bar) — the B3 elevation on S-07 shows the same bars bending up at 1.30 = L/5 of 6.50. Per spec §7 they are merged into main_bar.bottom with a note (bottom at mid-span), not left in additional_bars.

S2: the leader lines give a bottom main layer Ø9 @0.15 (alternating straight / bent), top bars Ø9 @0.15 over one support and Ø9 @0.30 at the other (both extending 0.40), and Ø6 @0.20 distribution bars; which top layer sits over the interior support is read from the leader positions — lowered score.
The lintel, sill band, tie column and corbel details carry no mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned (spec §0.2).

Lintel sizes on the architectural details: W1 (A-11) prints 'ทับหลัง ค.ส.ล.ขนาด0.10x0.25ม … Ø9มม4เส้น ปลอก Ø6มม@0.15มม' — the same as this S-06 detail; D1 (A-10) prints the door-head lintel 0.15x0.25 with the same bars. The S-06 generic detail (0.10 x 0.25) is kept here; the wider door-head lintel is recorded in the D1 schedule row's sheet warnings.
